previous_assumption: assumed a Renter being a party to a CommercialQuotation (rental_company_organization_id or renter_organization_id matches) was sufficient to let them see it, regardless of status
correction: A draft is the Rental Company still privately drafting terms -- confirmed the Renter side had zero status filtering anywhere. listQuotationsForRenter listed every status including draft, and getQuotation/listScopeItems/listOffers/makeOffer/acceptOffer all route through one shared loadAsParty helper that only checked party membership, never status. Fixed at that shared choke point: loadAsParty now throws NotFoundError when the caller is the Renter party and status is still draft, same hide-dont-403 pattern used everywhere else in this codebase -- covers every caller automatically. listQuotationsForRenter got the matching list-level filter. A quotation becomes visible to the Renter only once sendQuotation moves it to sent. Separately, client pointed out requirement.quotation_requested notifications (added a few commits earlier) still had no dashboard attention item -- RentalCompanyDashboard's Waiting-on-you panel had no entry for it at all, unlike every other actionable item there. Added one, fetched via listRequestedQuotations gated on rfq.respond, same fulfilled-cross-reference (against CommercialQuotation.quotationResponseId) as the Quotations page's Requested tab.
